entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Wh-What should we do...?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Playing a game like we always do[n]doesn't seem quite right...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Thank you for today. Um, for letting me[n]come to your home, that is...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I didn't think you'd allow me to do so...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I was worried that if I visited[n]without the intention of playing[n]shogi, it would be misconstrued...
What do you mean?
I'm glad you came.[clr 27]
I was going to invite you.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I-I didn't have any ulterior motives...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: B-But if I wanted to follow[n]the couple's playbook and make[n]the first move, well...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I-I'm completely in a panic, thanks to[n]your off-the-board strategies...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: R-Really!? I was just following[n]the couple's playbook...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I wanted to make the first move![n]And I thought, I'd go, hrah! Checkmate!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I-I'm in a panic... I wish I could use[n]my defensive formations in real life...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Wh-What is that supposed to mean?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I-Is this reverse checkmate...?[n]Did you already make the first move!?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I-I'm completely in a panic, thanks to[n]your off-the-board strategies...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Um, th-there's something[n]I'd like to ask of you...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Please don't laugh...?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Um, I want us to be together... forever.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I love being by your side...
